description: AH-1J displayed on the campus of the Army Command and Staff University in Tehran. It wears 2-4173, but an AH-1J carrying that same serial is separately recorded at Chahar Zebar in Kermanshah province, so the marking here cannot be taken as identity and the tail number is left blank.
